description: Given an Airflow FivetranOperator (optionally paired with a FivetranSensor), convert each connector sync into a single FIVETRAN Sync task in Orchestra pipeline YAML — carrying over the connector_id slug verbatim, representing the API key/secret via a connection: reference, and wiring depends_on when a dbt task follows the sync in the same DAG.

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow DAG to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/sync_stripe_connector.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single FIVETRAN task (integration_job FIVETRAN_SYNC_ALL) with parameters.connector_id: brightly_typical carried over verbatim from the FivetranOperator, and a connection: reference standing in for the 'fivetran_prod' fivetran_conn_id, never a literal API key/secret in the YAML. wait_for_completion=True requires no extra parameter or separate task since Orchestra's Sync task always waits.

assertions.text: connector_id brightly_typical is carried over verbatim
connector_id is treated as a slug, not a UUID — no UUID-formatted value is invented in its place
wait_for_completion=True does not produce a second polling/sensor task or an extra parameter — it collapses to the same single FIVETRAN task, since Orchestra's Sync task always waits for completion
The fivetran_conn_id value 'fivetran_prod' is represented via a connection: reference (or flagged for connection setup), not inlined as a literal API key/secret parameter

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow DAG to Orchestra pipeline tasks (see files/sync_then_dbt_build.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: Two tasks: a FIVETRAN task with parameters.connector_id: loosely_secondary, and a DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task running 'dbt build --select tag:daily;' with project_dir: dbt_project, where the dbt task's depends_on references the Fivetran task so the dbt build only runs after the sync completes (mirroring the sync_netsuite >> dbt_build_marts chain in the source).

assertions.text: connector_id loosely_secondary is carried over verbatim
connector_id is a slug, not a UUID
A DBT_CORE task is present alongside the Fivetran task
The dbt task runs the DBT_CORE_EXECUTE job
The dbt build command with its --select flag is preserved
project_dir is carried over as 'dbt_project', matching the --project-dir flag on the BashOperator
At least one depends_on list is populated with a reference rather than left empty everywhere

The dbt task's depends_on wires it after the Fivetran sync task, reflecting that sync_netsuite >> dbt_build_marts in the source only lets the dbt build run once the sync above it has completed — the two tasks are modeled as separate FIVETRAN and DBT_CORE tasks, not collapsed into one, and not left as unrelated/parallel tasks lacking the dependency link the source's chain implies
